title: Traditional British Cornish Pasty Recipe
description: A classic British dish originating from Cornwall, this recipe is a delicious and comforting meal for any occasion. Perfect for a cold winter's day or a hearty snack.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality beef for best results

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Diced potatoes are perfect for this recipe

ingredients.name: Swede
ingredients.notes: Also known as rutabaga, this adds great flavor

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds depth to the filling

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Season to taste for the perfect balance of flavors

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Use unsalted butter for the flaky pastry crust

ingredients.name: Flaky pastry
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade pastry for the best results

instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes, swede and onion.
In a large pan, sauté the chopped onion until softened.
Add the chopped potatoes and swede to the pan and cook until tender.
Add the beef to the pan and cook until browned.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Roll out the flaky pastry on a lightly floured surface.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Add the beef and vegetable mixture to the center of the pastry.
Brush the edges of the pastry with butter and fold the pastry over the filling.
Crimp the edges of the pastry to seal the pasty.
Cut a small slit in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
